# Batch & Build

> Batch & Build is a small studio selling printable planners, trackers, spreadsheet templates, guides and simple scripts as instant digital downloads on Gumroad. Tagline: "Planners & templates that make life easier."

- Website: https://batchandbuildco.co.site/
- Shop: https://mortonix631.gumroad.com/
- All templates by category: https://batchandbuildco.co.site/shop.html
- Social: @batchandbuildco on Instagram (https://www.instagram.com/batchandbuildco/), Pinterest (https://www.pinterest.com/batchandbuildco/), Tumblr (https://batchandbuildco.tumblr.com/)
- Contact: info@batchandbuildco.co.site

## Featured products
- [Job Application Tracker](https://mortonix631.gumroad.com/l/job-application-tracker): $7. 6 printable US Letter pages to log applications, prep for interviews and track follow-ups (PDF).
- [Paycheck Budget Pack](https://mortonix631.gumroad.com/l/paycheck-budget-pack): $8. 8 undated printable worksheets for splitting each paycheck into bills, spending and savings, for people paid weekly or biweekly (PDF).
- [Batch & Build: 30-Day Macro-Friendly Meal Prep Guide](https://mortonix631.gumroad.com/l/batch-and-build): $9. 17-page guide with 9 repeatable high-protein recipes, 2 cook nights a week, 4 weeks mapped, grocery lists and storage notes (PDF).
- [Small Business Scripts](https://mortonix631.gumroad.com/l/invoice-payout-reorder-kit): $19. 3 Python 3 command-line tools (invoice from JSON, payout ledger from CSV, reorder list from inventory). No installs, no API keys.

## Blog
- [Blog index](https://batchandbuildco.co.site/blog/)
- [How to Budget Biweekly Paychecks (Without a Monthly Budget That Never Fits)](https://batchandbuildco.co.site/blog/how-to-budget-biweekly-paychecks.html): A simple, paycheck-by-paycheck method for budgeting when you're paid every two weeks, including what to do in the months with three paychecks.
- [30-Day Meal Prep Grocery List: How to Shop Once a Week and Cook Ahead](https://batchandbuildco.co.site/blog/30-day-meal-prep-grocery-list.html): A practical, flexible grocery list framework for a month of high-protein meal prep, plus tips for shopping on a budget and storing food safely.
